evidence.reason: The checked-in workflow still has DIFF_OPTS="--text --no-textconv --no-ext-diff" without --no-renames. git log -p enables rename detection by default, so a pure rename emits only a rename header with no added-line hunks; gitleaks scans added lines, so content moved from an exempt/allowlisted path (e.g. policy/denylist/patterns.yml) to a non-exempt path is never scanned, and path-based rules no longer apply to the renamed path. This is a fail-closed denylist bypass, not merely a hardening proposal. Adding --no-renames to DIFF_OPTS is the smallest compatible fix; if the workflow is generated from policy/templates/denylist.yml as the finding states, the template must be updated and the workflow regenerated, but the defective line is present in the current workflow.
